## 🎯 Next Steps

### Immediate Actions
1. ✅ Review all documentation files
2. ✅ Conduct user acceptance testing
3. ✅ Verify all templates display correctly
4. ✅ Test all forms and validations
5. ✅ Check responsive design on mobile devices

### Before Production Deployment
1. Configure production database (PostgreSQL)
2. Set DEBUG=False in settings.py
3. Configure ALLOWED_HOSTS
4. Set SECRET_KEY from environment variable
5. Configure static files CDN (if needed)
6. Configure media storage (S3/Azure Blob Storage)
7. Enable HTTPS/SSL certificate
8. Set up logging and monitoring

### Post-Deployment
1. Monitor error logs
2. Verify all features working
3. Check performance metrics
4. Set up automated backups
5. Ensure security measures are active
